project.name: Sumika Shell
project.tagline: A modular, extension-driven desktop shell for Hyprland — built with Quickshell.

extensions.name: Sasayaki Voice Input
extensions.summary: Local voice dictation engine in Go with optional live translation.
extensions.description: Sasayaki (ささやき) is the most mature voice input path: a Go control binary embedding a Python sherpa-onnx engine, kept warm by a systemd user service over a versioned Unix-socket protocol. Push-to-talk from the bar or a global keybinding, fully offline SenseVoice/Paraformer models (SHA-256 pinned downloads), compositor-aware text paste (wtype/ydotool/xdotool, XWayland and kitty special cases), and optional OpenAI-compatible translation.
features: Go binary + QML bar button & popup

extensions.name: Voice Input
extensions.summary: Chinese-first dictation with speculative translation pipeline.
extensions.description: The classic voice input extension: Chinese-first SenseVoice-small-int8 dictation through a long-lived Python daemon, ffmpeg 20 dB input boost, and a speculative-translation race pipeline (silence-detect → transcribe → translate → accept on exact source match) driven by OpenAI-compatible providers. Bar button, popup, settings page and a full settings TUI.

extensions.name: Input Method
extensions.summary: Fcitx5/Rime schema switcher and XKB layout switcher in the bar.
extensions.description: Bar button + popup for CJK input: cycle Fcitx5/Rime schemas (per-language rows with layout sub-view) or XKB keyboard layouts, with an OSD for mode changes. Bundled sumika-input-method CLI covers status/set/deploy/schemas/config.

extensions.name: Keyboard Remap
extensions.summary: Per-device keyd profiles, Fn-row modes and a key-code inspector.
extensions.description: Keyboard remapping on top of keyd: per-device profiles with preset tables and custom target overrides, rendered via jq to /etc/keyd/sumika.conf and applied through pkexec/run0/sudo. Apple fn-mode (hid_apple) toggle, GTK4 KeyTest capture tool for evdev/XKB/keyd codes, and a curses settings TUI plus QML editor overlay.

extensions.name: Screenshot
extensions.summary: Region/fullscreen capture, OCR, reverse image search and recording.
extensions.description: One bar button for every capture flow: fast slurp+grim region capture to clipboard/cliphist/file, fullscreen and 3s-delayed monitor shots, a frozen-snapshot region selector with edit (satty/swappy) and pixelate-redaction, Google-Lens reverse search, multi-language PaddleOCR, and screen recording (wf-recorder / gpu-screen-recorder backends, optional audio) with live stop-bar. Coordinates bar freeze/unfreeze so popups never appear in captures.

extensions.name: Musubi File Backup
extensions.summary: Musubi: rsync/Samba backup and config distribution with a TUI.
extensions.description: SMB-share backup and sync management: configure jobs, run or schedule them, restore — from the Musubi TUI, the settings page or the bar popup. A bundled status helper feeds connection state to the bar; a polkit rule (review before installing — see project review) gates privileged mounts.

extensions.name: Windows VM
extensions.summary: Dockurr Windows VM lifecycle: install, run, RDP, web console.
extensions.description: Full lifecycle manager for a Dockurr Windows 11 VM in Docker: requirement checks (KVM/docker/compose/FreeRDP/disk), guided install with resource-derived defaults, start/stop, web console, RDP connect, live log/progress monitoring, and a guarded destructive remove. QML settings page, curses TUI, and bar popup all drive the same CLI.

extensions.name: Theme Settings
extensions.summary: Theme engine: 22 themes, wallpaper management, Hyprland effects.
extensions.description: The theme engine of Sumika Shell: 22 curated theme packs (colors.toml + generated adapters for foot/kitty/alacritty/ghostty/Hyprland/Quickshell/nvim and lock screen), a live-preview picker TUI, wallpaper management (single file, folder rotation via systemd transient timer + swaybg, or theme-tinted solid), and Hyprland effect modes (performance/balanced/visuals) applied live via IPC.
extensions.note: Lite download: per-theme wallpaper backgrounds excluded.

extensions.name: Active Window
extensions.summary: Focused-window title pill with compositor-aware action menu.
extensions.description: Left-bar pill showing the focused window title + icon via the compositor-agnostic zwlr_foreign_toplevel protocol, with per-screen filtering and desktop/distro identity when nothing is focused. Click opens a context menu: labwc gets minimize/maximize/close; Hyprland gets toggle-floating, fullscreen, pop-out (float+pin+top) and move-to-scratchpad — all targeting the clicked window by address.
